keyword.en: concrete pump outlet pressure vs pumping pressure
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵出口压力和泵送压力怎么区分

title.en: Outlet Pressure and Pumping Pressure on Pinjin Sheets
title.zh: 品锦参数页上的出口压力和泵送压力

description.en: Some Xingtai concrete pump rows say max. outlet pressure. Others say pumping pressure. The label is part of the cell.
description.zh: 邢台有的混凝土泵行写最大出口压力，有的写泵送压力。标题是格子的一部分。

h1.en: Outlet Pressure and Pumping Pressure on Pinjin Sheets
h1.zh: 品锦参数页上的出口压力和泵送压力

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints pressure in MPa on most concrete pumps made in Xingtai, but the label is not one phrase. Trailer rows such as Electric 20 and Diesel 30 say max. outlet pressure. HBT8018, HBT80-16, LZ-60, LZ-80, the tractor pump and the rural diesel pump say pumping pressure. Electric 15 and B500S-83D print no pressure row. The words are not a conversion factor.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的多数混凝土泵以 MPa 印压力，但标题不是同一句话。电动20、柴油30这类拖泵行写最大出口压力。HBT8018、HBT80-16、LZ-60、LZ-80、拖拉机泵和农村柴油泵写泵送压力。电动15和 B500S-83D 没有压力行。这两个词不是换算系数。

body.en: Read the label before the number. Electric 20 prints max. outlet pressure 10 MPa. Electric 40 prints 23 MPa. Electric 80 prints 40 MPa. Diesel 120 prints 40 MPa. HBT8018 prints pumping pressure 40 MPa. LZ-60 prints pumping pressure 35 MPa. The tractor and the rural diesel pump print pumping pressure 15 MPa. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print bar on these concrete pump rows.
body.zh: 先读标题再读数字。电动20的最大出口压力为 10 MPa。电动40为 23 MPa。电动80为 40 MPa。柴油120为 40 MPa。HBT8018 的泵送压力为 40 MPa。LZ-60 的泵送压力为 35 MPa。拖拉机泵和农村柴油泵的泵送压力为 15 MPa。河北品锦机械没有在这些混凝土泵行上印 bar。

body.en: Electric 15 prints motor power, output and distance ranges, and it does not print a pressure. B500S-83D prints 7.5 kW and 380 V, and it does not print a pressure. Do not copy 10 MPa from Electric 20 onto either page. A missing pressure cell stays blank.
body.zh: 电动15印了电机、产量和距离范围，没有印压力。B500S-83D 印了 7.5 kW 和 380 V，没有印压力。不要把电动20的 10 MPa 抄到这两页。缺了的压力格保持空白。

heading.en: What the pressure cell is not

body.en: The printed MPa is the catalogue cell for that concrete pump. It is not a blockage-clearing procedure, and it is not a slump specification except where a page actually prints slump. Only the Tractor-Driven 4100 prints slump, 180–220 mm. Ask through the contact page if a job needs a pressure the sheet does not show.
body.zh: 印出的 MPa 是这台混凝土泵的目录格。它不是清堵步骤，也不是坍落度，除非该页真的印了坍落度。只有拖拉机带动4100印了坍落度 180–220 mm。如果工况需要参数页没有的压力，请走联系页。

question.en: Do outlet pressure and pumping pressure convert by a published factor?
question.zh: 出口压力和泵送压力有公布的换算系数吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints one label or the other on each Xingtai concrete pump page. There is no factor telling you to turn one phrase into the other.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械在每台邢台混凝土泵上只印其中一个标题。没有系数让你把一种说法换成另一种。

answer.en: Electric 15 and B500S-83D do not print a pressure row. The rural diesel pump does print 15 MPa.
answer.zh: 电动15和 B500S-83D 没有压力行。农村柴油泵印了 15 MPa。

answer.en: Concrete pump rows cited here print MPa. Do not rewrite a cell into bar.
answer.zh: 这里引用的混凝土泵行以 MPa 印出。不要把格子改写成 bar。

question.en: Does a higher MPa on one model apply to the next model?
question.zh: 一个型号更高的 MPa 能用到下一个型号吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 40 MPa and Electric 60 prints 35 MPa. Keep each figure on its own page.
answer.zh: 不能。电动80印 40 MPa，电动60印 35 MPa。数字留在各自页面。
